name: Lysa Hora: The Haunted Hill
storyline:
The player takes on the role of a student named David, who moves to a big city in search of a new life. He soon begins to be haunted by obsessive nightmares about a mysterious mountain that seems to be calling him. Over time, the dreams become more and more realistic, showing underground tunnels, abandoned buildings, and a strange device that once contained a dangerous force.

Trying to understand the origin of his dreams, the hero finds classified documents in the city archive that confirm the existence of Soviet experiments and hidden underground complexes under Lysa Gora. This prompts him to go to the mountain itself to find the source of the nightmares and reveal the secret hidden underground.
summary: A sci-fi horror where ancient rituals intertwine with Soviet experiments. With a strong emphasis on atmosphere, discover a forbidden place inspired by a real location through fortification tunnels, hidden laboratories, and ancient shrines.
